name: AppClassificationAgent
description: Classifies the submission as Chatbot, Form Application, Dashboard, Document Generator, REST API, Workflow System, Static Website or Hybrid Application by weighing runtime-discovery signals and repository code signals, with per-class scores, evidence, confidence and the testing strategy for Action Generation.

inputs.name: runtime_profile
inputs.description: RuntimeDiscoveryAgent output; ignored when only a login wall was visible

inputs.name: repo_graph
inputs.description: Knowledge graph: routes, pages, forms, components, agents

inputs.name: code_chunks
inputs.description: Code chunks scanned for chat / file-generation / charting / approval patterns

inputs.name: repo_model
inputs.description: Repo model; dependencies drive library signals

outputs.name: app_classification
outputs.description: app_type, confidence, components (for Hybrid), basis, note, scores, evidence, testing_strategy
